title: chore(github-tool): bump the tool package to 0.3.0
body:
The tool's code changed since 0.2.0 was published to the workspace registry (pull request read without the mergeability wait, case-insensitive code owner filtering, comment listing with the bot flag). A published version is never overwritten, so the portal refuses to publish the same version with different contents and no workflow would deploy. The workflow packages pin the exact tool version from this manifest, so they pick up 0.3.0 on the next build.

Verified: `bun run check`; web and tool tests.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
